name: peer-tool-validation-latency
benchmarkCommand: bash -lc 'start=$(node -e "console.log(Date.now())"); env -u PI_SESSION_PRESENCE_TITLE_BASE npm run check; status=$?; end=$(node -e "console.log(Date.now())"); node -e "const s=Number(process.argv[1]); const e=Number(process.argv[2]); console.log(\"METRIC check_seconds=\"+((e-s)/1000).toFixed(3))" "$start" "$end"; exit "$status"'
